name: aiagent
lineage: harness-research draft -> playbook draft (2.4) -> v2.5.0 submission -> locked v2.5.0 (patches P1-P7 applied)

assembly.method: concatenate files in order, joined by one blank line; no rewriting of module content
invariants: Fixed module order as declared here; no dynamic reordering, ever.
The stable part (order + selects) is byte-identical across turns and across sessions for a given (prompt_version, model, platform, surface).
No timestamps, session ids, or other dynamic content in the stable part.
Assembly happens once at session start. Mid-session changes (mode, cwd, model) are APPENDED as system messages - never reassembled.
The dynamic tail is always last; per-session content follows dynamic_tail_order exactly.
The version stamp is rendered inside the environment block of the dynamic tail (data, not policy).

frozen.rule: Frozen sections are the behavioral contract (core = contract, modules = capability/context). They may change only in a prompt MAJOR (2.x -> 3.0) and require explicit owner signoff; every change is recorded in CHANGELOG.

upgrade_matrix.capability_change: module file update; prompt minor if the module set changes
upgrade_matrix.model_change: model dimension (model/<model>.md); prompt patch at most

skill_manage.guard: Task -> Use skill -> Observe gap -> Recurring? -> Propose/update -> Verify -> Persist. NEVER task-failed -> auto-rewrite.

features.reviewer: deferred — phase-3 eval gate (diff-review eval vs single-pass self-check)
